nt-mit.title: MIT OpenCourseWare, 18.781 Theory of Numbers (Spring 2012), lecture notes, instructor Abhinav Kumar; notes prepared by Joseph Lee in collaboration with Kumar
nt-mit.notes: Lecture topics 1-11 and 20-26 cover the exact foundational problems in this pack; consultation of HTML topic catalog, not a claim of copying or fully auditing the PDF proofs.

nt-stein.title: William Stein, Elementary Number Theory: Primes, Congruences, and Secrets (2009)
nt-stein.notes: Author-hosted legal online textbook covering primes, modular arithmetic, quadratic reciprocity and continued fractions; some chapters assume prior abstract algebra.

nt-stanford-recip.title: Stanford, Pairing-Based Cryptography notes, Number Theory: Quadratic Reciprocity
nt-stanford-recip.notes: Gauss criterion, parity argument and Eisenstein lattice count proof; reference for proof structure, not verbatim source.

nt-grinberg.title: Darij Grinberg, 18.781 (Spring 2016): Floor and arithmetic functions, revised 2026
nt-grinberg.notes: Sections 2.1–2.6 cover arithmetic functions, convolution, and Möbius inversion; lecture manuscript was independently composed.

nt-prime-reciprocal.title: University of Toronto lecture notes, series of reciprocals of primes, section 1.3.4
nt-prime-reciprocal.notes: Finite Euler product inequality and comparison to the harmonic series.

nt-hmc-prime-reciprocal.title: Harvey Mudd College Math Fun Facts, Sum of Prime Reciprocals

nt-dirichlet-ap.title: Wikipedia, Dirichlet's theorem on arithmetic progressions

nt-mit782.title: MIT 18.782, Introduction to Arithmetic Geometry (Fall 2013), Lecture Notes 8, Section 8.3
nt-mit782.notes: p-adic Hensel lemma and proof, a stronger version than the integer-polynomial finite-lift proof used in lecture 010000.

nt-stanford-pell.title: Stanford open lecture notes, The Pell Equation
nt-stanford-pell.notes: Period-to-Pell connection and classification by powers of a least positive norm-one unit; independent exposition, not a line-by-line audit.

nt-lagrange-cf.title: Wikipedia, Periodic continued fraction and Lagrange theorem

nt-stanford-squares.title: Stanford open notes, Sum of Two Squares
nt-stanford-squares.notes: Euclidean division in Gaussian integers and splitting primes.

nt-grinberg-gaussian.title: Darij Grinberg, Number Theory, Lecture 17 (2025)
nt-grinberg-gaussian.notes: Norms, factorization and Fermat two-squares theorem; independent exposition.

nt-utk-squares.title: University of Tennessee, Fermat two-square theorem
nt-utk-squares.notes: Complete criterion for positive integers to be Gaussian norms.

nt-hac.title: Menezes, van Oorschot and Vanstone, Handbook of Applied Cryptography, Chapter 4
nt-hac.notes: Section 4.2, Fact 4.23 quantitative strong-liar bound and Algorithm 4.24 Miller-Rabin.

nt-cornell-mr.title: Cornell CS 4820, Miller-Rabin primality testing notes
nt-cornell-mr.notes: Strong witnesses, Carmichael numbers, counting argument.

nt-nptel-primitive.title: NPTEL Number Theory, Module 4 Lecture 3, Primitive Roots for Powers of Odd Primes
nt-nptel-primitive.notes: Binomial lifting proof for primitive roots to odd prime powers.

nt-ucsd-field.title: UCSD Algebra Course Notes (2021), finite multiplicative subgroups
nt-ucsd-field.notes: Root-count approach to cyclicity of multiplicative subgroups of fields.

nt-unb-field.title: University of New Brunswick, Applications to Field Theory: finite multiplicative subgroups
nt-unb-field.notes: Finite subgroup cyclicity using group exponent and polynomial root bound.

nt-dlmf-euler.title: NIST Digital Library of Mathematical Functions, section 27.4, Euler Products and Dirichlet Series
nt-dlmf-euler.notes: Euler products with absolute-convergence hypotheses; zeta, Mobius, and totient Dirichlet generating functions.

nt-dlmf-zeta.title: NIST Digital Library of Mathematical Functions, section 25.2, Definition and Expansions of the Riemann Zeta Function
nt-dlmf-zeta.notes: Zeta series domain and boundary; later analytic continuation is outside this course.

nt-dlmf-characters.title: NIST Digital Library of Mathematical Functions, section 27.8, Dirichlet Characters
nt-dlmf-characters.notes: Definition, principal character, count and character orthogonality.

nt-dlmf-l.title: NIST Digital Library of Mathematical Functions, section 25.15, Dirichlet L-functions
nt-dlmf-l.notes: L-series and Euler product for Re s>1 and the separate nonvanishing theorem at s=1.

nt-tao-elementary.title: Terence Tao, 254A Notes 1: Elementary multiplicative number theory (2014)
nt-tao-elementary.notes: Detailed proofs of summation tools, character methods and nonvanishing; cited as deeper reading; present manuscripts independently composed and do not reproduce his full nonvanishing proof.

nt-tao-ap.title: Terence Tao, The prime number theorem in arithmetic progressions, and dueling conspiracies (2009)
nt-tao-ap.notes: Differentiates Dirichlet infinitude from sharper prime number theorem in progressions, and discusses nonvanishing.

nt-wiki-dirichlet-ap.title: Wikipedia, Dirichlet's theorem on arithmetic progressions

nt-reed-nonvanishing.title: Reed College mathematics lecture notes, Nonvanishing of Dirichlet L-functions at s=1
nt-reed-nonvanishing.notes: Trigonometric square-completion for nonreal characters; positivity and Landau argument for real characters, independently reformulated and expanded in this course.

nt-mit785-dirichlet.title: Andrew V. Sutherland, MIT 18.785 Number Theory I (2021), Lecture 18: Dirichlet L-functions, primes in arithmetic progressions
nt-mit785-dirichlet.notes: §18.4 for the character-projection proof and Dirichlet-density distinction. Referenced as proof source, not text duplicated.

nt-kedlaya-analytic.title: Kiran Kedlaya, Dirichlet characters and L-functions (algebraic number theory notes)

nt-kedlaya-ap.title: Kiran Kedlaya, Primes in arithmetic progressions
nt-kedlaya-ap.notes: §4.3 logarithmic Euler-product expansion and character reconstruction.

nt-unm-zeta.title: University of New Mexico, complex analysis course notes, §9.3 Meromorphic Continuation of zeta(s) to Re(s)>0
nt-unm-zeta.notes: Partial-summation integral featuring fractional part and pole at one.

nt-ucl-landau.title: University College London, Introduction to Analytic Number Theory, §4 Landau lemma
nt-ucl-landau.notes: Positive coefficient Dirichlet series and nonvanishing. The course proves an explicit disk version sufficient for the argument.

nt-afp-dirichlet.title: Manuel Eberl, Dirichlet L-Functions and Dirichlet’s Theorem, Archive of Formal Proofs (2017)
nt-afp-dirichlet.notes: Independent formalization of nonvanishing and Dirichlet theorem.

nt-mathlib-nonvanishing.title: Mathlib, NumberTheory.LSeries.Nonvanishing documentation
nt-mathlib-nonvanishing.notes: Outline of positive-series and trigonometric nonvanishing arguments.

nt-afp-prime-bounds.title: Manuel Eberl, Elementary Prime Bounds, Archive of Formal Proofs

nt-mathworld-r2.title: Eric W. Weisstein, Sum of Squares Function (MathWorld)
nt-mathworld-r2.notes: Definition of signed ordered representations, prime-factor formula, Jacobi divisor formula, theta generating function and summatory counts.

nt-mathworld-circle.title: Eric W. Weisstein, Gauss's Circle Problem (MathWorld)
nt-mathworld-circle.notes: Lattice-point interpretation and the elementary O(R) discrepancy boundary; stronger bounds are outside this installment.

nt-conrad-finite-fields.title: Keith Conrad, Finite Fields (University of Connecticut)
nt-conrad-finite-fields.notes: Construction, classification, Frobenius, subfield lattice, polynomial factorization and irreducible counting; compared to proof developed in the manuscript.

nt-bconrad-finite.title: Brian Conrad, Elementary Explanation of Finite Field Mysteries (Stanford)
nt-bconrad-finite.notes: Elementary field uniqueness and Frobenius behavior, without assuming advanced Galois theory.

nt-flint-rabin.title: FLINT Project, Irreducibility testing over finite fields
nt-flint-rabin.notes: Rabin irreducibility criterion and implementation via modular polynomial powering and gcd.

nt-dfg-irreducible.title: Daniel Flores Galiote, Irreducible polynomials over finite fields
nt-dfg-irreducible.notes: Degree-divisibility factorization and Mobius counting formula.

nt-wiki-sum-of-two-squares.title: Wikipedia, Sum of two squares theorem
